newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia energy minister to discuss Tenaga tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia energy minister to discuss Tenaga tariffs.

text.p: Malaysia's Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie will hold a news conference on Wednesday to discuss a tariff changes proposal from utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd.
An advisory from Moggie's department said the briefing would be held at 1415 local time (0615 GMT). No further details were provided.
Analysts have said Tenaga could be granted a tariff increase of between five and 10 percent.
Crimped by the high cost of buying power from Independent Power Producers (IPPs) and large capital expenditures, Tenaga has sought to increase rates and reduce energy costs.
